items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1961-02-10
items.q: But I know Mr. Paul Newman and Sidney Poitier and Diane Cowell. And, well, I'm around them anyway.

ctx.x: How do you compare my career? I was a kid. I was a kid. I don't do no more in the United States that my wife's with me, you know. Yeah. A young girl there, you know. You can figure it out yourself. Who all is in the Paris movies? Well, I know the stars. I kind of know all the people, you know. But I know Mr. Paul Newman and Sidney Poitier and Diane Cowell. And, well, I'm around them anyway. I mean, they're with them. They, you know, have a little fun, you know. Well, now, you've made movies in the United States.…
How does the, how many working conditions? What?
